statement: For every m > n >= 2 the reduced class variety of the padded permanent is not normal, so GCT VI's RH is false.
GCT VI's hph1det is false: along lambda = (m-1,1), d = 1 the count needs at least m-2 coordinates.
For n >= 2 and m >= (n+1)^25, given polytopes with PH1's counting property, no lambda satisfies either condition of OH.
depends_on: Burgisser-Ikenmeyer-Panova 2019, main theorem; GCT II, Theorem 8.2
